jp: キミではボクに勝てない・・・

限界がないっていうの！？

But, soon...

絶対にアイツの仇を・・・！！

jp: それ以上、動いたら・・・

Fine, let's fight.
Let's stop this.
Fine, let's fight.

en: Kukukuku... Lost your nerve at this late hour!?

en: Fight, Cain!! As long as I live, I will hunt you down to kill you!

jp: お前の仲間達も血を流すことに
en: Leave me be, and your friends will bleed for it too!!

...Fine, let's fight.
Cain!?

en: It's okay. I'm not going to lose.
But....

Cain......

いくらなんでも、この状態じゃ

en: And yet, something bothers me. Something....

いったい何があるというのだ？
en: (Such composure at death's door... What could he be holding?)

あの傷じゃ、放っておいても

en: He talks tough, but with those wounds he's got a few hours left, even untouched.

相打ちでも狙わなきゃ、
アイツにカインを倒すのは無理だ
en: Forget trading stabs. Unless he goes for a double kill, he can't take Cain down.

Whoa!!?

跡形もなく吹き飛ぶ・・・

I win, Cain. Now blow away with me!!!
Uwaaaaaah!!
Cain!!

jp: ふははははははははっ！！！
en: Fuhahahahahahaha!!
Young man
